<a id="flush"></a>

## `flush`

```silk
pub effect fn flush<E, ?R, S: Sink<E ? R>>(recorder: &Recorder, sink: &mut S) -> ()
! E | OutOfMemoryError ? R | &mut Allocator
```

Drains at most one recorder capacity of completed spans and logs, then snapshots cumulative metrics.
A full batch contains 32 records. A failed send charges the records it consumed to the drop counters.

<a id="exportBatches"></a>

## `exportBatches`

```silk
pub effect fn exportBatches<E, ?R, S: Sink<E ? R>>(recorder: &Recorder, sink: &mut S) -> ()
! E | OutOfMemoryError ? R | &mut Allocator | &mut MonotonicClock
```

Flushes once a second until the caller cancels the exporter or the sink fails.
Run it outside the recorder's ambient scope to keep its requests out of the exported trace.
